name: OsmosisProofling-Bench-Putnam-NT
description: A benchmark of Putnam-level mathematics problems reformulated for evaluation of language models' problem-solving and proof-generation abilities. It measures a model's capacity to produce correct solutions and coherent mathematical arguments on challenging undergraduate-level contest problems. Tasks emphasize formal reasoning, multi-step deduction, and clear exposition of proofs.
reputation: A niche research benchmark used in math-reasoning and theorem-proving evaluations; limited adoption outside specialized research groups.
